target.title: docs: add ClawHub glossary labels
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Adds missing zh-CN glossary entries for existing ClawHub documentation titles so generated localized docs can keep those labels stable.

AI-assisted: yes.

## Why This Change Was Made

The branch preserves the existing ClawHub mirrored navigation contract and only adds glossary labels for the existing `ClawHub CLI` and `Publishing on ClawHub` titles. It does not add local OpenClaw-owned ClawHub pages or remove any mirror-owned ClawHub routes.

## User Impact

Readers of localized docs get consistent ClawHub labels while the published ClawHub docs navigation continues to expose the routes supplied by the ClawHub mirror.

## Evidence

- Branch rebased and validated on `origin/main` `0ff265838b6f6b00bcdb23b9d97fae730f8ad48a`; pushed head is `ad031f8ce7301beba58e9cd5d5b0a9354bfc45fa`.
- Final diff against that base: `docs/.i18n/glossary.zh-CN.json` only, 8 insertions.
- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD` - passed.
- `pnpm docs:check-i18n-glossary` - passed. Local run warned that Node `v24.14.1` is below the repo's Node engine floor for this checkout, but the command exited `0`.
- `pnpm docs:map:check` - passed. Local run warned that Node `v24.14.1` is below the repo's Node engine floor for this checkout, but the command exited `0`.
- `node scripts/check-docs-i18n-glossary.mjs` - passed.
- `node scripts/generate-docs-map.mjs --check` - passed.
- Post-push GitHub checks for head `ad031f8ce7301beba58e9cd5d5b0a9354bfc45fa` are passing or skipped, including `check-docs`, `Real behavior proof`, `dependency-guard`, `actionlint`, `preflight`, `security-fast`, and `security-sensitive-guard`.
